text:
Nora (People Ops): Quick update — rolling out two small but important policy changes today: 1) a new Flex Reserve PTO bucket for unexpected caregiving/emergency use, and 2) an adjusted travel reimbursement cap for domestic flights and per-diem. Read on for details and how to opt in. :sparkles:

Micah: Thanks — is Flex Reserve automatic or opt-in?

Nora (People Ops): Opt-in. You can convert up to 8 unused PTO hours per quarter into Flex Reserve (max 40 hours/year). It only covers sudden caregiving or emergency time off, not planned vacations.

Dalia: How does approval work if I need to use Flex Reserve for a same-day caregiver emergency?

Nora (People Ops): Manager approval needed, but we’ve added a 24-hr auto-approve fallback for urgent cases — manager can review retroactively. Use the "Emergency Leave" option when submitting.

Priya (ENG): Is there a form or flow? Can eng leads see balances in the HR dashboard?

Nora (People Ops): Yes — new flow in the People Portal under Time Off -> Flex Reserve. Leads see a read-only balance and a pending request. Link: https://people.redwood.example.com/flex-reserve (internal only).

Raj: About travel — what's changing on the reimbursement cap?

Nora (People Ops): Domestic airfare cap moves from $600 to $450 for standard bookings; if you need premium or last-minute tickets, pre-approval through the Travel Exception form is required. Daily per-diem for meals moves to a flat $55/day in NA. Full policy: https://docs.redwood.example.com/travel-reimbursements

Micah: Any changes for international travel?

Nora (People Ops): Intl policy unchanged today — exceptions handled case-by-case. We’ll revisit for APAC later this quarter.

Priya (ENG): Does this affect existing travel credits or events already booked?

Nora (People Ops): No retroactive changes. If you already booked within the old caps before today, reimbursements follow the old rules. New policy applies to travel with travel start date on or after 2026-05-01.

Dalia: Can Flex Reserve hours be cashed out?

Nora (People Ops): Nope — not cashable, not payable on termination. It’s specifically for time off use only.

Raj: Any changes to code-of-conduct reminders tied to travel?

Nora (People Ops): Good call — we added a short travel conduct attestation in the Travel Exception form: one checkbox confirming you’ll follow our Code of Conduct and local laws while representing Redwood. Nothing onerous, just a reminder.

Micah: Will there be a Q&A session?

Nora (People Ops): Yes — 30-min drop-in tomorrow 10:00am PT in #all-hands-brief for quick questions. We’ll also host office-hours next week for managers on approving Flex Reserve.

PeopleOps-Bot: Policy doc updated: /policies/time-off/flex-reserve (version 1.0).

Priya (ENG): Appreciate the clarity, Nora. Small ask — can managers get a quick one-pager for approval guidance?

Nora (People Ops): On it. I’ll drop a one-pager in #people-ops and email leads by EOD. :tada:
